xBRIEFInfo.description: Plan for PAN-4896: pan connect on macOS prints a Linux-only systemd-run warning

plan.title: pan connect on macOS prints a Linux-only systemd-run warning
plan.author: agent:claude-opus-5-5

narratives.Problem: On macOS, `pan connect` (and `pan up`/`pan restart`) print the PAN-2804 warning '[dashboard] WARNING (PAN-2804): could not start the dashboard via systemd-run…'. spawnDashboardSystemdUnit in src/cli/commands/restart.ts already returns null on non-Linux without trying systemd-run, but spawnDashboardDetached prints the warning unconditionally after the null return, so darwin gets a warning about an attempt that never happened.
narratives.Proposal: Wrap the existing PAN-2804 console.warn in spawnDashboardDetached with `if (process.platform === 'linux')`, leaving the warning text, systemd-run arguments and spawn options untouched. Add a darwin unit test (no systemd-run call, no PAN-2804 warning, pid handle still works) and a linux positive-control test (exactly one PAN-2804 warning when systemd-run throws) to tests/unit/cli/restart-spawn-pid.test.ts. Add one sentence to the D-10 macOS bullet in docs/ANYWHERE-ARCHITECTURE.md describing the darwin spawn path.
narratives.NonGoals:
- Fixing the tmux '[tmux] WARNING (PAN-1798)' sibling in src/lib/tmux.ts (file is at its 1167-line allowlist cap; tmux backend is not pan connect's default path)
- Adding a second platform guard around the systemd-run call (spawnDashboardSystemdUnit already guards it)
- Changing spawnDashboardSystemdUnit's return type to distinguish skipped from failed
- Any launchd-based process isolation for the dashboard on macOS
- Changing behavior, warning text, or systemd-run arguments on Linux, including non-systemd Linux which must still warn
- Editing scripts/file-size-allowlist.txt

autoDecisions.summary: Gate only the console.warn on process.platform === 'linux'; do not add a guard around the systemd-run call.
autoDecisions.rationale: spawnDashboardSystemdUnit already returns null on non-Linux (restart.ts line 363), so the attempt is already Linux-only; the warning is the only defect. Minimum diff.

autoDecisions.summary: Use the predicate process.platform === 'linux' rather than 'systemd is available'.
autoDecisions.rationale: Non-systemd Linux, or a failing systemd-run --user, is exactly the cgroup-sharing hazard PAN-2804 warns about, so those hosts must keep the warning.

autoDecisions.summary: Exclude the tmux PAN-1798 warning in src/lib/tmux.ts from this issue.
autoDecisions.rationale: It only fires under terminal.backend: tmux (not pan connect's Herdr default) and src/lib/tmux.ts is at its 1167-line allowlist cap, so a fix needs an extraction item; that is a separate issue.

autoDecisions.summary: Add a linux positive-control test alongside the darwin test.
autoDecisions.rationale: The existing 'systemd-run is unavailable' test silences console.warn without asserting it, so nothing proves the warning still fires on Linux; without it the darwin assertion could pass because the warning was deleted outright.

metadata.sizeJustification: Three small items in one subsystem; well under the files_scope and subsystem limits.

items.title: Gate the PAN-2804 dashboard warning on process.platform === 'linux'

expected_outputs: diff shows only the added platform check and comment around the unchanged PAN-2804 console.warn

narrative.Action: In src/cli/commands/restart.ts, function spawnDashboardDetached, after `child.unref();` (line 314 at base 22769ffffe8), wrap the existing console.warn('[dashboard] WARNING (PAN-2804): could not start the dashboard via systemd-run. ' + 'It shares the invoking process tree\'s cgroup; restarting that unit/scope will kill it.') in `if (process.platform === 'linux') { … }`, preceded by the comment `// PAN-4896: only Linux tries systemd-run; elsewhere (macOS launchd) the` / `// detached child is the normal path, so there is nothing to warn about.` Do not change the warning text, spawnDashboardSystemdUnit, the spawn call, or the returned handle. See PRD WI-1 for the exact before/after.

items.title: Given src/cli/commands/restart.ts, when grepping for `if (process.platform === 'linux')` in spawnDashboardDetached, then it returns the line directly enclosing the PAN-2804 console.warn
Given the diff against origin/main, the PAN-2804 warning string is byte-identical and spawnDashboardSystemdUnit, the spawn options and the returned stop/pid handle are unchanged
npm run typecheck exits 0 with the change applied
Unit-test that darwin emits no PAN-2804 warning while linux still warns

expected_outputs: restart-spawn-pid.test.ts passes, including the new darwin test and the new linux warning test

narrative.Action: In tests/unit/cli/restart-spawn-pid.test.ts, inside describe('dashboard spawn pid handles'), add two tests (PRD WI-2). (1) 'does not attempt systemd-run or warn on darwin (PAN-4896)': vi.spyOn(process, 'platform', 'get').mockReturnValue('darwin'); processMocks.spawn.mockReturnValue({ pid: 4321, unref: vi.fn() }); const warn = vi.spyOn(console, 'warn').mockImplementation(() => {}); call spawnDashboardDetached(config, createDashboardBundleFixture()); assert processMocks.execFileSync.mock.calls has no call with first arg 'systemd-run', warn.mock.calls has no call whose first arg contains 'PAN-2804', and await handle.pid!() resolves to 4321. (2) 'warns once on linux when systemd-run fails (PAN-2804)': keep the beforeEach linux pin, make processMocks.execFileSync throw, mock spawn, spy console.warn, call spawnDashboardDetached, assert exactly one warn call whose first arg contains 'could not start the dashboard via systemd-run'. Filter warn calls by substring rather than asserting zero total warns. Use the existing fake timers from beforeEach; no real waits. Checkpoint: if loadConfigSync/openDashboardLogStdio throw under the darwin mock, vi.mock the offending module at file top in the style of the existing child_process mock.

items.title: Given process.platform mocked to 'darwin' and spawn mocked, when spawnDashboardDetached runs, then the test asserts execFileSync receives no 'systemd-run' call and console.warn receives no message containing 'PAN-2804'

Given process.platform 'linux' and execFileSync throwing, when spawnDashboardDetached runs, then the test asserts console.warn emits exactly one message containing 'could not start the dashboard via systemd-run'
npx vitest run tests/unit/cli/restart-spawn-pid.test.ts exits 0 with all existing and new tests passing
Given the platform gate from gate-pan2804-warning-linux is reverted locally, when the test file runs, then the darwin test fails (the test pins the gate)
Document the darwin dashboard spawn path in ANYWHERE-ARCHITECTURE D-10

narrative.Action: In docs/ANYWHERE-ARCHITECTURE.md, in the '- **D-10 macOS.**' bullet under '## pan connect (W-LINK9, FR-25)', after the sentence ending '`pan up` on a Mac with the agent loaded does not start a second supervisor.', insert: 'The dashboard server itself runs as a plain detached child of the supervisor: only Linux starts it in a `systemd-run` transient unit, so macOS prints no PAN-2804 systemd warning (PAN-4896).' Keep the bullet's existing line wrapping style (~90 columns, two-space continuation indent). No other doc mentions PAN-2804; docs/TERMINAL-BACKENDS.md needs no change.
